name: What factors affect the cost of flooring replacement?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of flooring replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of flooring replacement is influenced by the type of material chosen, the total square footage of the area, and any necessary subfloor repairs. Higher-end materials like certain hardwoods will increase costs compared to more budget-friendly options like laminate. Labor costs for installation are also a significant factor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include material type, area size, and subfloor repairs. Material and labor are primary cost drivers.
